title: Fallback Routes
description: Baseline operator routes for known runtime failures until deeper runtime wiring is implemented.

routes.operator_action: Capture the raw planner output, keep the approval gate closed, and log the parser failure in the handoff notes.
Keep the gate in waiting status, surface missing approvers in next actions, and do not force phase advancement.
Retry with the interpreter sibling or repo-local .venv binary before PATH; if it still fails, stop and document the environment gap.
Regenerate summaries, compare the live phase snapshot with gate evaluation, and hand off any remaining divergence with fixture details.
